finishes.name: Gray
finishes.notes: Ascent face and outer ring. Hex sampled from Ventures' combo photos (median of the frame, #abafb7–#afb4b7); the inner hub is darker (#76797b).

models.name: Ventures Ascent
models.notes: CNC aluminum 5/6 reel sold in Ventures Fly Co's Fly Flinger combo and starter packs (venturesflyco.com, Oct 2026); sold alone as 'Ascent Reel 5/6' in 2021–24. Ventures publishes no dimensions, so every figure is an estimate: rim ~3.4″ (82–91 mm) from scaling combo photos against the Fly Flinger's cork grip; arbor ≤ 0.53 × rim from where backing shows through the ports; width 0.95″ is typical of budget CNC 5/6 reels. Ventures spools it with WF5F and 30 lb backing but gives no yardage. An olive version appears only in 2022 Amazon renders and is left out.
